limits: Only exact fixed-canvas opaque PNGs and deterministic threshold160 are assessed.
3px guide corridor can hide short connections, near-overlap changes or added junctions. Faint additions above threshold can be missed.
New annotation or dark texture can trigger false alarms; ambiguous ink abstains.
Four fiducial patches and guide coverage are limited registration checks, not general image alignment.
No OCR, terminal graph, missing-wire classifier, full semantic correctness, electrical/fabrication qualification or absence proof.
